front: Why do retail and offices decentralise?
back: Transport change, cheaper land with parking, customers in the suburbs, competition, investment and congestion in the centre.

front: Why do factories move to the edge?
back: High land cost in the inner city, need for space and single-storey buildings, congestion and better road access at the edge.
